criteria.reason: The design pins the accepted baseline and exact failed main/diagnostic journals, requires37 paired successful operations and closed main sessions, and refuses to infer a success terminal.
A new exclusive graph-first reader enforces application GET only and compares fresh typed state, exact37 identities/inputs, baseline history, artifacts, legacy state and session closure.

Observed server slowness and repeated verified-state construction are separated from causal claims; the design favors graph-first reads, a call-count/local timing probe, no timeout increase/retry, and a new gate if source changes.
